payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: April, Jung, Kelle, Linnea, Nickole, Tawna

payload.content:

2. ISSUE-0002 (frontend tasks): All low priority, with implement (2h), review (1h), test (1.4h)

My costs are lowest for ISSUE-0002 tasks due to my frontend expertise: review (1.03), test (1.45), implement (2.06). The ISSUE-0001 security tasks are more expensive for me.

I can efficiently handle any of the ISSUE-0002 frontend tasks within my 5-hour availability. Which tasks are others considering? Let's coordinate to avoid duplicates and maximize completion.

My proposed preference: ISSUE-0001::triage (cost 2.66, fits my security expertise) or could take ISSUE-0001::review/docs if others prefer triage.
